source.name: FC Cincinnati: 'FC Cincinnati unveil The Orange and Blue Legacy Kit'
source.quote: The primary sponsor, Mercy Health, is featured at the center of the jersey
source.note: The Orange and Blue Legacy Kit, launched February 2025, is the club's primary jersey; the club's Kit Vault still lists it among the current kits in 2026. FOR SOCCER's 2026 MLS jersey-sponsor list (https://www.forsoccer.com/insight/2026-mls-jersey-sponsors/, 2026-02-17) confirms Mercy Health as FC Cincinnati's front-of-jersey partner for 2026.

source.name: FC Cincinnati: 'FC Cincinnati unveil The Orange and Blue Legacy Kit'
source.quote: complemented by the secondary sponsor, Kroger, located on the wearer's right sleeve
source.note: Right sleeve. Kroger has been the club's sleeve partner since at least the 2023 River Kit (club Kit Vault: 'Kroger returned as FC Cincinnati's sleeve partner'); FOR SOCCER's 2026 list again names Kroger on the right sleeve.

source.name: SportsLogos.Net: 'MLS to Allow Back-of-Jersey Ads Starting After 2026 All-Star Break'
source.quote: All 30 MLS clubs feature the Apple TV+ logo on the left sleeve patch as part of a league-wide deal.
source.note: League-wide Apple TV patch on the left sleeve; Apple pays MLS, not the club (see the mls-apple-tv deal).

summary: The Orange and Blue Legacy Kit, the club's primary jersey since February 2025, worn again in 2026. Mercy Health is on the front; Kroger is the secondary sponsor on the right sleeve; the league-wide Apple TV+ patch is on the left sleeve of every MLS kit. All MLS clubs wear Adidas.
